subject: Pharma shipment STR-ORD 2-8 °C
body:
Hello,

please quote Stuttgart (STR) to Chicago (ORD) for 6 thermo boxes of vaccine samples, 700 kg, 2.8 cbm, ready 27.11.2026, we deliver to STR.

The shipment must be kept at +2 to +8 °C throughout, active temperature control required. Cheapest compliant option, EUR.

Best regards
Dr. Nina Schulz
Clinical Logistics
Neckar Pharma GmbH
